decisions.reason: The drain housing builds on existing drainage knowledge but the polymer concrete material is new, so the firm can assimilate only with moderate effort.
A floor-level shower drainage system is a core extension of the firm's established drainage products, enabling effective learning and improvement.
Designer shower drainage leverages the firm's drainage expertise and design capabilities, supporting ongoing refinement.
The shower element integrates slope and drainage, closely related to existing shower products, so the firm can interpret results well.
Backflow-protected basement floor drains draw on established drainage and safety know-how, making them highly assimilable and worth keeping.
The air-admittance valve requires specialised valve and plastic knowledge outside the firm's core metal drainage expertise, limiting its capacity to learn and improve.
